description: The customer wants to cancel an existing order. The AI should understand this is a request to stop processing the order and possibly initiate a refund or cancellation.
The customer wants to modify details of an existing order, such as quantity, product, or delivery information.
The customer wants to update the shipping address of an order before it is shipped.
The customer wants to know the cancellation fee for an order. This is an informational request, not an actual cancellation.
The customer wants to view or verify the invoice of an order. The AI should recognize this as an invoice or billing inquiry.
The customer wants to know what payment methods are accepted. This is an informational request, not a transaction.
The customer wants to understand the refund policy, including conditions and limits.
The customer wants to submit a complaint about a product, service, or shopping experience. This is negative feedback that may require attention.
The customer wants to reach customer service for general inquiries or assistance.
The customer wants to connect directly with a human agent instead of interacting with a bot or automated system.
The customer wants to create a new account on the platform, including providing personal information.
The customer wants to delete their existing account, requiring removal of their data and access.
The customer wants to know available delivery options, such as standard, express, or store pickup.
The customer wants to know the estimated delivery time for an order.
The customer wants to update their account information, such as name, email, phone number, or password.
The customer requests to receive or generate an invoice for a completed or paid order.
The customer wants to receive a refund for a canceled order or returned product.
The customer wants to subscribe or unsubscribe from newsletters, promotional emails, or notifications.
The customer is experiencing a problem with payment, such as a failed transaction, card decline, or payment discrepancy.
The customer wants to place a new order, including selecting products, quantity, and payment method.
The customer has forgotten their password and wants to recover account access using email or OTP verification.
The customer encounters issues while creating an account, such as duplicate email or system errors.
The customer wants to provide a review or rating for a product or service they have used.
The customer wants to add or set up a new shipping address for orders or account delivery preferences.
The customer wants to switch from one account to another, such as logging out and logging into a different account.
The customer wants to track the current status of an order from processing to delivery.
The customer wants to track the progress of a refund, including processing status and expected completion.
